svg.title: How SiPath runs a design
svg.desc: A design file, the Python API or an AI agent over MCP drives an attempt graph. The reference chain runs synth, floorplan, macros, physical, place, cts, route_analog, route_digital, route_repair, fill, extract and signoff. Every step runs its variants as attempts in parallel, a score selects one and the next step continues from it; others are kept as branches or rejected. Placement can run adaptive rounds, a failed repair patch is retried with a full re-route, and ECOs patch the signed-off result. Outputs are the verdict, the layout and reports, hardened views and, for harness designs, precheck and chip integration.
svg.text: ↻ iterates inside the step · dashed: when the design needs it
variants run as attempts, in parallel
each attempt's fingerprint (inputs, parameters, parent) lets --resume reuse it; fork starts a new run from any attempt
